WITH driver_counts AS (
  SELECT d.driverId, COUNT(q.qualifyId) AS qualifying_records
  FROM drivers AS d
  LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.driverId = d.driverId
  GROUP BY d.driverId
), average_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(qualifying_records) AS average_records
  FROM driver_counts
)
SELECT dc.driverId,
       dc.qualifying_records,
       CAST(dc.qualifying_records AS REAL) / ac.average_records AS ratio_to_average
FROM driver_counts AS dc
CROSS JOIN average_count AS ac
ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
